eyebrow: Dependencies the object list won't show
code:
-- Cross-database query, trivial in SQL Server:
SELECT o.OrderID, c.CustomerName
FROM Sales.dbo.Orders o
JOIN CRM.dbo.Customers c
  ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID;

-- Linked server query:
SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(FinanceLinkedSrv,
  'SELECT AccountID FROM GL.Accounts');
caption: Neither pattern has a drop-in equivalent on Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
